why.raw stays append-only: an edited raw file destroys the only thing a rebuild can restore from; flipping `processed` is the one sanctioned edit, and deletion only under a declared retention obligation
why.usage/log.md row appended: the friction field is the whole improvement flywheel; a skill that skips it under pressure makes corp-os-improve blind
why.derived-layer writes have a proposal beh: a proposal that lives only in chat dies with the session and leaves no record of what the gate saw -- the declines especially, which are the only trace of what someone chose not to know
why.the missing layer is raised as a proposa: a layer is a structural change to what the OS can hold, and the gate is what stops one being shaped wrong in passing. The proposal is the artifact that survives the session; a run that quietly invents a directory to render a panel leaves nothing to review
why.the declared layer has an index_line: build_index.py renders this banner for any layer declared without an index_line, and lists its entries as bare links. It is the exact machine-visible signature of a layer declared without the configure interrogation -- the shape mistake this check exists to catch, made once already in this repo
